source_inspections.evidence_extract: The October 21 preliminary-injunction order in California Nurses Association v. truth_social_media_inspection.finding: All 40 new posts were reviewed as leads. Accessible images and representative video frames were inspected; audio and captions were not transcribed. The set consisted mainly of endorsements, turnout appeals, campaign footage, praise, media screenshots and unsupported Iran claims, with no separate qualifying action established.

trump_tv_inspection.finding: The stream ID and four October 21 library entries were unchanged, and no October 22 upload appeared by cutoff. Titles, dates, durations and stable IDs were inspected; direct footage, audio and captions were unavailable. No qualifying new item was located in the material reviewed.
